title: Warranty Coverage Technician Timesheet Standard: Billable Hours by Visit Outcome
content:
**Standard.** For a Warranty Coverage technician visit whose labor is billed, the method hours follow the outcome of the visit as recorded on it:

1. A **repaired** visit on a claim that **already carries a labor charge entry** continues the job: its method hours are its hours on site rounded up to the billing increment, with no minimum.
2. A visit at which the technician only diagnosed or measured and left the repair for **parts on order** takes the labor minimum as its method hours, whatever the hours on site.
3. Any other visit: no different hours method applies under this standard.

## Reading the records

- The outcome is the one recorded on the visit: repaired, part on order, no defect found or customer no-show.
- "Already carries a labor charge entry" means the warranty charges show a labor charge entry on that same claim before this visit is billed.
- Hours on site are the labor hours recorded on the visit.

## Outcome and method

| Visit outcome | Labor charge entry already on the claim | Method hours |
|---|---|---|
| repaired | yes | hours on site rounded up to the billing increment, no minimum |
| repaired | no | no different hours method under this standard |
| part on order | either | the labor minimum, whatever the hours on site |
| no defect found | either | no different hours method under this standard |

## Worked (hypothetical: billing increment 0.5 hour, labor minimum 1.0 hour)

- Repaired, labor charge already on the claim, 0.3 hours on site: 0.5 hours.
- Repaired, labor charge already on the claim, 1.2 hours on site: 1.5 hours.
- Part on order, 2.6 hours on site: 1.0 hour, the labor minimum.
